title: Terraform module for VPC observability pipeline with staged rollouts and probe-driven circuit breaker
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: implement a reusable Terraform module that provisions a production-ready observability stack inside customer VPCs. The module should assemble Prometheus (k8s helm or managed), Grafana (with RBAC dashboards + provisioning), an OpenTelemetry Collector topology (ingest -> processors -> exporters), and log-shipping via Fluent Bit/Vector to S3 or centralized logging. It must support staged upgrades with a probe-driven circuit breaker and automated rollback hooks so upgrades are safe in Private deployment environments.

Scope:
- Core module that can be composed into the Private deployment IaC (VPC module).
- Support for: helm_release or chart_module toggles (k8s vs managed), optional managed Grafana, Prometheus operator vs kube-prometheus-stack, OTEL collector as sidecar vs daemonset, and configurable log forwarder (Fluent Bit / Vector).
- Upgrade orchestration: allow canary stage (N% of cells or nodes), health probes, SLO checks, and automatic pause/rollback on failure thresholds.
- Health checks: readiness/liveness probes, synthetic scrape targets, alert rules and a health endpoint for upgrade controller to call.
- Drift detection and reconciliation hooks to report divergences to the console and create PRs or tickets when manual intervention required.

Non-goals: building a new observability stack from scratch, replacing existing monitoring tools across all customers immediately. This is an IaC module and orchestration layer only.
acceptance_criteria: Module can be instantiated in a VPC environment with documented variables and examples
Automated upgrade runs by terraform apply + orchestration pipeline: canary -> ramp -> full with configurable thresholds
Circuit breaker trips and reverses changes when synthetic health checks or SLO regressions exceed configured limits
Prometheus, Grafana, OTEL Collector, and log forwarder resources created with optional managed toggles
Module exposes outputs for dashboard URLs, Prometheus endpoints, collector endpoints, and S3 log paths
Integration tests (terraform + k8s manifests) exist in the infra-ci pipeline and pass in a staging cell
Security review checklist completed and KMS/HSM integration validated for log encryption in transit and at rest
tasks: Design module API: inputs/outputs/feature flags (helm vs managed, operator selection, retention defaults)
Create TF module skeleton with examples: examples/basic, examples/managed-grafana, examples/upgrade-canary
Implement health probes: synthetic target, scrape test job, otel collector health endpoint
Build upgrade controller glue: plan/apply guard scripts, post-apply probes, rollback hooks
Add Terraform lifecycle blocks / resource replace mitigation for managed resources
Write integration tests in infra-ci: terraform plan/apply/destroy on staging cluster
Document runbooks: rollback procedure, emergency disable of telemetry, debugging checklist
Open initial PR and request security review and infra-ownership review
notes: Initial design call (2026-02-25): agreed to prioritize minimal surface for first iteration: kube-prometheus-stack + OTEL daemonset + Fluent Bit
Plan to support a managed Grafana option in follow-up (post-1.0)
Trade-offs: operator-based Prometheus gives better Kubernetes integration but increases upgrade surface; we will expose a switch to choose operator vs chart-managed Prometheus
Considerations for private deployments: network egress restrictions -> exporter endpoints must be configurable (S3 vs internal log-collector) and TLS enforced
Key metrics for upgrade decisions: scrape success rate (>99.5%), rule evaluation latency, OTEL exporter error rate, log-forwarder dropped events
We will reuse existing alerting templates from 'observability-playbooks' Confluence space
Estimate increased after discovery: added canary orchestration and automated rollback (+3 points)
